phase3_findings.description: src/sqllens/tools/_format.py lines 389-404: no test checks query_info row_count when the last run_sql is an introspection query whose result is withheld; a refactor moving the row-count update into the non-introspection branch would go undetected.

src/sqllens/tools/query_database.py lines 290-299: a components_to_blocks failure re-raises the sanitized internal error before build_agent_trace runs, so with show_details on the client loses _meta sqllens/agent_trace on this failure path, unlike the AgentRunError path.

tests/unit/test_safety.py lines 855-858: the grouping comment 'An inline comment right after SHOW is caught by the parse root.' also heads the nested leading-comment case '/* a /* b */ c */ SHOW TABLES', which is not an inline comment after SHOW.
